_comment: Replay fixtures for llm_client.py. Two layers:
exact    - sha256(request)[:16] -> response text. Populated by LLM_MODE=record.
defaults - intent-routed fallbacks. A cassette miss must never break a run.
A fixture value is either a plain string, or {rules:[{contains,reply}], default}.
Tokens {{goal}} and {{step_goal}} are substituted from the live request.

rules.reply: surprise: heavy rain is forecast all day, the outdoor stops need rethinking
thin: the search came back empty, downstream steps have little to work with

observer.default: ok: the step produced a usable result for the next step

## Your plan

**Morning (09:00-12:00)**
- Start at the covered market hall. Open from 10:00; budget roughly 800 units for breakfast and a snack [https://example.org/city-guide].
- Walk 12 minutes to the museum. General admission 500 units, quietest before 11:00.

**Afternoon (12:00-16:00)**
- Lunch near the museum, around 900 units.
- Public library reading terrace, free, covered seating if the weather turns [https://example.org/city-guide].

**Evening (16:00-19:00)**
- Observation deck if the sky clears, otherwise the market hall reopens for evening stalls.
- Transit day-pass covers every leg above [https://example.org/transit].

**Budget check:** roughly 3,200 units of the stated allowance, leaving headroom for one unplanned stop.

**Note:** heavy rain is forecast, so the outdoor legs are marked optional and every one has an indoor substitute.
